cats.d: Leafy, crisp and bright. Apple or pear keeps them friendly.
Peel first, then juice. Sunshine in a glass.
Carrots, beets and sweet potato. Earthy, sweet and filling.
Soft fruit and melon. Switch to the orange filter for these.
Tiny, strong, ginger-forward. One gulp and done.
Sweet, colourful and fun names. Noah-approved.
Juice plus bubbles, ice and a garnish. Party-ready.

recipes.title: Everyday green
recipes.blurb: The green juice to start with: cool cucumber, crisp celery and a squeeze of lemon.
steps: Cut the cucumber, celery and apple into 2-inch pieces. Peel the lemon.
Start the juicer, then feed a small bundle of spinach followed by a piece of apple or cucumber. Repeat.
Finish with the lemon and ginger, stir and drink cold.
notes: Roll the spinach into a tight ball so the auger grabs it in one go.
recipes.healthier: Already low in sugar. Use the orange filter to keep more of the fiber.

recipes.title: Green lemonade
recipes.blurb: Tastes like lemonade, looks like a smoothie. Kale sneaks in unnoticed.
steps: Strip kale leaves off thick stems and roll them up.
Juice kale between pieces of apple and cucumber so nothing stalls.
Add the lemon last. Pour over ice.
notes: Too sour? Add a third apple. Too sweet? Add more cucumber.
recipes.healthier: Already low in sugar. Use the orange filter to keep more of the fiber.

recipes.title: Celery, apple & ginger
recipes.blurb: Clean, savoury and a little spicy. A classic morning glass.
steps: Cut celery into 2-inch pieces so the strings don't wrap the auger.
Alternate celery and apple through the chute.
Juice the ginger last, stir and serve straight away.
notes: Short celery pieces are the secret. Long strings are what clog juicers.
recipes.healthier: Already low in sugar. Use the orange filter to keep more of the fiber.

recipes.title: Apple, spinach & mint
recipes.blurb: Bright mint and sweet apple make this the gentlest green.
steps: Core is fine, just remove stems. Cut apples into chunks.
Wrap mint inside the spinach and feed with apple pieces.
Finish with lime and serve over ice.
recipes.healthier: Use the orange filter to keep more fiber, and add cucumber to stretch it with less sugar.

recipes.title: Kiwi cucumber cooler
recipes.blurb: Tangy kiwi and pear in a pale green, super-refreshing glass.
steps: Fit the orange filter for soft fruit. Peel the kiwis.
Feed spinach, then kiwi, pear and cucumber in turns.
Stir well, the kiwi makes it lightly thick.
recipes.healthier: Swap one of the fruits for cucumber or celery to cut the sugar, and drink it with a meal.

recipes.title: Pineapple kale crush
recipes.blurb: Pineapple hides the kale completely. A great first green for skeptics.
steps: Fit the orange filter. Cut pineapple into 2-inch chunks, no skin or core.
Feed kale rolled around the mint, then pineapple and cucumber.
Stir and pour over ice.
recipes.healthier: Use the orange filter to keep more fiber, and add cucumber to stretch it with less sugar.

recipes.title: Green glow
recipes.blurb: Romaine, pear and parsley. Soft, grassy and very drinkable.
steps: Tear romaine into bundles. Cut pears and cucumber into chunks.
Feed parsley tucked inside the romaine, then the pears and cucumber.
Finish with the lemon.
recipes.healthier: Already low in sugar. Use the orange filter to keep more of the fiber.

recipes.title: Fennel & pear
recipes.blurb: Light aniseed flavour with sweet pear. Surprisingly grown-up.
steps: Cut fennel bulb into wedges, fronds included.
Alternate fennel with pear and apple.
Add lemon, stir and serve cold.
recipes.healthier: Swap one of the fruits for cucumber or celery to cut the sugar, and drink it with a meal.

recipes.title: Fresh-pressed OJ
recipes.blurb: Just oranges. Cold-pressed tastes nothing like the carton.
steps: Peel the oranges completely, white pith is fine.
Break into segments and feed a few at a time.
Drink within the hour for the best flavour.
notes: Want bits? Use the orange filter instead.
recipes.healthier: Use the orange filter to keep more fiber, and add a handful of spinach or cucumber.

recipes.title: Sunrise carrot orange
recipes.blurb: Orange, carrot and ginger. Sweet, warming and gorgeous colour.
steps: Scrub carrots, no need to peel. Cut into 2-inch pieces.
Juice carrots and oranges in turns, ginger in the middle.
Stir and serve.
recipes.healthier: Use the orange filter to keep more fiber, and add a handful of spinach or cucumber.

recipes.title: Pink grapefruit mint
recipes.blurb: Tart and bracing, softened with orange and fresh mint.
steps: Peel all the citrus.
Wrap the mint around a segment and feed it first.
Juice the rest and serve over ice.
recipes.healthier: Already low in sugar. Use the orange filter to keep more of the fiber.

recipes.title: Strawberry creamsicle OJ
recipes.blurb: Orange, strawberries and a drop of vanilla. Tastes like dessert.
steps: Fit the orange filter for the berries.
Juice oranges, strawberries and lemon.
Stir in the vanilla and serve.
recipes.healthier: Swap one of the fruits for cucumber or celery to cut the sugar, and drink it with a meal.

recipes.title: Lemon ginger zinger
recipes.blurb: Apple-sweet with a lemon kick and real ginger heat.
steps: Cut apples into chunks, peel the lemon.
Juice everything, ginger between the apples.
Stir and taste. Add more apple if it's too fiery.
recipes.healthier: Use the orange filter to keep more fiber, and add a handful of spinach or cucumber.

recipes.title: Ruby citrus
recipes.blurb: Grapefruit, orange and pomegranate in a deep red glass.
steps: Peel the citrus and scoop out the pomegranate seeds (no white pith).
Feed the seeds a spoonful at a time between citrus segments.
Stir and serve chilled.
recipes.healthier: Swap one of the fruits for cucumber or celery to cut the sugar, and drink it with a meal.

recipes.title: Carrot apple ginger
recipes.blurb: The most popular juice in the world for a reason.
steps: Scrub carrots and cut everything into 2-inch pieces.
Alternate carrot and apple, ginger in the middle.
Stir and serve.
recipes.healthier: Use the orange filter to keep more fiber, and add a handful of spinach or cucumber.

recipes.title: ABC juice
recipes.blurb: Apple, beet, carrot. Sweet, earthy and bright magenta.
steps: Peel the beet if it's very earthy. Cut into small chunks, beets are hard.
Juice the beet between apple pieces.
Finish with carrots and lemon.
notes: Wear an apron. Beet stains everything, the juicer included. Rinse right after.
recipes.healthier: Use the orange filter to keep more fiber, and add a handful of spinach or cucumber.

recipes.title: Heart beet
recipes.blurb: Beet, pear and apple with lemon and ginger.
steps: Cut beet into small pieces.
Alternate beet, pear and apple.
Juice lemon and ginger last.
recipes.healthier: Swap one of the fruits for cucumber or celery to cut the sugar, and drink it with a meal.

recipes.title: Sweet potato pie
recipes.blurb: Sweet potato, apple and pear with cinnamon. Fall in a glass.
steps: Scrub the sweet potato and cut into small cubes.
Juice it between apple and pear pieces, then the celery.
Stir in cinnamon. Let it settle a minute, then stir again.
recipes.healthier: Swap one of the fruits for cucumber or celery to cut the sugar, and drink it with a meal.

recipes.title: Golden carrot turmeric
recipes.blurb: Carrot, orange and fresh turmeric. Earthy and golden.
steps: Scrub carrots and turmeric. Peel the orange.
Juice turmeric between carrots.
Add the orange, stir in pepper and serve.
notes: Turmeric stains. Rinse the juicer parts straight away.
recipes.healthier: Already low in sugar. Use the orange filter to keep more of the fiber.

recipes.title: Red root
recipes.blurb: Beet, carrot, celery and parsley. Earthy and savoury.
steps: Cut everything into 2-inch pieces.
Feed parsley wrapped around a celery piece.
Juice the rest, ginger last.
recipes.healthier: Already low in sugar. Use the orange filter to keep more of the fiber.

recipes.title: Red pepper sunset
recipes.blurb: Sweet red pepper, carrot and apple. Mild and veggie-sweet.
steps: Seed the pepper and cut into strips.
Juice pepper, carrots and apple in turns.
Serve over ice.
recipes.healthier: Already low in sugar. Use the orange filter to keep more of the fiber.

recipes.title: Watermelon mint
recipes.blurb: Pure summer. Pink, light and barely needs anything else.
steps: Fit the orange filter. Cut watermelon into chunks, seeds are fine.
Feed slowly, it's very watery.
Juice the mint and lime, stir and serve ice cold.
notes: Close the anti-drip lever between glasses, watermelon keeps flowing.
recipes.healthier: Use the orange filter to keep more fiber, and add a handful of spinach or cucumber.

recipes.title: Apple strawberry
recipes.blurb: Sweet strawberries with crisp apple. Instant favourite.
steps: Fit the orange filter.
Juice strawberries between apple pieces.
Pour over ice.
recipes.healthier: Swap one of the fruits for cucumber or celery to cut the sugar, and drink it with a meal.

recipes.title: Piña fresca
recipes.blurb: Pineapple, orange and lime. Tropical and zingy.
steps: Fit the orange filter. Remove pineapple skin and core.
Juice pineapple, orange, lime and mint.
Stir and serve.
recipes.healthier: Swap one of the fruits for cucumber or celery to cut the sugar, and drink it with a meal.

recipes.title: Purple grape
recipes.blurb: Red grapes, blueberries and apple. Deep purple and naturally sweet.
steps: Fit the orange filter. Pull grapes off stems.
Feed grapes and blueberries a handful at a time between apple pieces.
Stir and serve.
recipes.healthier: Swap one of the fruits for cucumber or celery to cut the sugar, and drink it with a meal.

recipes.title: Pear ginger
recipes.blurb: Mellow pear with a warm ginger finish.
steps: Fit the orange filter for pears.
Juice pears and ginger.
Add lemon to keep it from browning.
recipes.healthier: Use the orange filter to keep more fiber, and add a handful of spinach or cucumber.

recipes.title: Melon medley
recipes.blurb: Cantaloupe, honeydew and lime. Soft, sweet and fragrant.
steps: Fit the orange filter. Remove rinds and scoop seeds.
Juice melons slowly.
Add lime and serve cold.
recipes.healthier: Use the orange filter to keep more fiber, and add a handful of spinach or cucumber.

recipes.title: Cherry limeade
recipes.blurb: Sweet cherries, apple and lime. Tart, ruby red.
steps: Fit the orange filter. Pit every cherry, pits can damage the auger.
Juice cherries between apple pieces.
Finish with lime.
notes: Tart cherries are a popular night-time drink.
recipes.healthier: Swap one of the fruits for cucumber or celery to cut the sugar, and drink it with a meal.

recipes.title: Mango sunrise
recipes.blurb: Mango, orange and carrot. Thick, golden and smoothie-like.
steps: Fit the orange filter. Cut mango flesh into chunks.
Alternate mango with carrot so the soft fruit keeps moving.
Juice the oranges and stir well.
recipes.healthier: Swap one of the fruits for cucumber or celery to cut the sugar, and drink it with a meal.

recipes.title: Ginger lemon shot
recipes.blurb: The classic wake-up shot. Spicy, sour, done in one gulp.
steps: Cut ginger into thin coins.
Juice ginger and lemons, then the apple to push everything through.
Pour into shot glasses. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
recipes.healthier: Already sugar-light. Take it with food if the ginger feels strong.

recipes.title: Golden turmeric shot
recipes.blurb: Turmeric, ginger and orange with a pinch of pepper.
steps: Scrub turmeric and ginger, cut into thin coins.
Juice them between orange segments.
Stir in the pepper. Shake before pouring.
recipes.healthier: Already sugar-light. Take it with food if the ginger feels strong.

recipes.title: Green shot
recipes.blurb: Spinach, parsley, apple and lemon. Grassy and quick.
steps: Roll spinach and parsley into a tight ball.
Juice it between apple pieces.
Finish with lemon.
recipes.healthier: Already sugar-light. Take it with food if the ginger feels strong.

recipes.title: Fire shot
recipes.blurb: Ginger, lemon and a pinch of cayenne. For the brave.
steps: Juice ginger, lemons, chili if using, then the apple.
Stir in cayenne.
Serve in tiny glasses. Adults only.
recipes.healthier: Already sugar-light. Take it with food if the ginger feels strong.

recipes.title: Bunny juice
recipes.blurb: Carrot and apple. Sweet, orange and kid-proof.
steps: Scrub carrots, cut everything into chunks.
Let the kids feed pieces in, one at a time, with the pusher.
Pour into a fun cup.
recipes.healthier: Mix half and half with cold water for little ones, and serve it with a meal.

recipes.title: Hulk juice
recipes.blurb: Bright green but tastes like apple. Spinach is the secret.
steps: Cut apples and pear into chunks.
Feed spinach bundles between fruit pieces.
Serve with a straw.
recipes.healthier: Mix half and half with cold water for little ones, and serve it with a meal.

recipes.title: Pink lemonade
recipes.blurb: Strawberries, apple and lemon topped with water.
steps: Fit the orange filter.
Juice strawberries, apples and lemon.
Top up with cold water and ice.
recipes.healthier: Mix half and half with cold water for little ones, and serve it with a meal.

recipes.title: Purple power
recipes.blurb: Grapes and blueberries with apple. Deep purple and sweet.
steps: Fit the orange filter.
Juice grapes and berries between apple chunks.
Stir and serve.
recipes.healthier: Mix half and half with cold water for little ones, and serve it with a meal.

recipes.title: Watermelon lime fresca
recipes.blurb: Aguas-frescas style: watermelon juice, lime and bubbles.
steps: Fit the orange filter. Juice the watermelon and lime.
Fill glasses halfway with juice over ice.
Top with sparkling water and a mint sprig.
recipes.healthier: Use plain sparkling water, never tonic or soda, and fill the glass with more ice than juice.

recipes.title: Cucumber mint spritz
recipes.blurb: Spa water, but better. Cool cucumber and mint with bubbles.
steps: Juice cucumber, mint and lime.
Pour over ice, about ⅔ juice.
Top with sparkling water.
recipes.healthier: Use plain sparkling water, never tonic or soda, and fill the glass with more ice than juice.

recipes.title: Apple ginger fizz
recipes.blurb: Homemade ginger-beer feel without the sugar syrup.
steps: Juice apples, ginger and lime.
Pour over ice, half juice.
Top with sparkling water, stir gently.
recipes.healthier: Use plain sparkling water, never tonic or soda, and fill the glass with more ice than juice.

recipes.title: Warm spiced apple
recipes.blurb: Fresh apple juice warmed with cinnamon and orange peel. Winter mocktail.
steps: Juice all the apples into a small pot.
Add cinnamon, orange peel and cloves. Warm gently 5 minutes, don't boil.
Strain into mugs.
recipes.healthier: Use plain sparkling water, never tonic or soda, and fill the glass with more ice than juice.

recipes.title: Spicy pineapple margarita
recipes.blurb: No-alcohol margarita: pineapple, lime and a little jalapeño.
steps: Fit the orange filter. Juice pineapple, limes and jalapeño.
Rub glass rims with lime and dip in salt.
Pour over ice and top with a splash of sparkling water.
recipes.healthier: Use plain sparkling water, never tonic or soda, and fill the glass with more ice than juice.

recipes.title: Healthy start
recipes.blurb: A veggie-heavy morning juice with just enough apple.
steps: Fit the black filter. Wash everything and cut to fit the feed chute.
Juice the spinach between the apple pieces so it all gets pressed.
Stir and drink right away.
recipes.healthier: Swap one apple for another cucumber to cut the sugar.

recipes.title: Cucumber apple mint
recipes.blurb: Light and cooling. Tastes like a spa day.
steps: Fit the black filter. Cut cucumbers and apples to fit.
Juice the mint between apple pieces.
Pour over ice.
recipes.healthier: Use 3 cucumbers and 1 apple.

recipes.title: Orange pineapple
recipes.blurb: Sweet, sunny and pulpy. Breakfast in a glass.
steps: Fit the orange filter for a pulpier juice.
Juice the oranges and pineapple, alternating.
Stir and serve cold.
recipes.healthier: Top half the glass with sparkling water.

recipes.title: Apple mango
recipes.blurb: Thick, tropical and kid friendly.
steps: Fit the orange filter. Cut apples to fit.
Juice the mango between apple pieces; soft fruit presses best that way.
Stir well.
recipes.healthier: Add a carrot or two and use one less apple.

recipes.title: Blackberry apple pear
recipes.blurb: Deep purple, gently sweet, very pretty.
steps: Fit the black filter.
Juice the berries between apple and pear pieces.
Serve over ice.
recipes.healthier: Use a cucumber in place of the pear.

recipes.title: Pear raspberry ginger sparkler
recipes.blurb: Fizzy, pink and a little spicy. Great for parties.
steps: Fit the black filter. Juice pears, raspberries and ginger.
Fill glasses halfway with juice.
Top with sparkling water and ice.
recipes.healthier: Make it one-third juice, two-thirds sparkling water.

recipes.title: Carrot zinger
recipes.blurb: Carrot, orange and a big hit of ginger.
steps: Fit the black filter. Trim the carrots.
Juice everything, ginger in the middle.
Stir and drink fresh.
recipes.healthier: Already a good pick. Drink it with a meal so it's more filling.
